prompt: As of August 1, 2024, which NFL players were both league MVP and Super Bowl MVP in the same season?
answer:
As of **August 1, 2024**, six players had won both the **NFL regular-season MVP** and **Super Bowl MVP** in the same season:

| Season | Player | NFL MVP | Super Bowl MVP |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1966** | **Bart Starr**, Green Bay Packers | 1966 NFL MVP | Super Bowl I |
| **1989** | **Joe Montana**, San Francisco 49ers | 1989 NFL MVP | Super Bowl XXIV |
| **1993** | **Emmitt Smith**, Dallas Cowboys | 1993 NFL MVP | Super Bowl XXVIII |
| **1994** | **Steve Young**, San Francisco 49ers | 1994 NFL MVP | Super Bowl XXIX |
| **1999** | **Kurt Warner**, St. Louis Rams | 1999 NFL MVP | Super Bowl XXXIV |
| **2022** | **Patrick Mahomes**, Kansas City Chiefs | 2022 NFL MVP | Super Bowl LVII |

Thus, **Bart Starr, Joe Montana, Emmitt Smith, Steve Young, Kurt Warner, and Patrick Mahomes** are the players who accomplished this.
